travellers.notes: 29 weeks pregnant at departure, about 32 at return

pace.rule: nights = arrival day + full days needed for the half-day visits at this pace + easy days; quick visits fill afternoons; the calendar then adjusts

sizes.day_trip: A whole day, replaces a half-day visit

rules.text: Every stay is at least 2 nights
No intercity move on a peak travel day; short local hops are allowed with a note
Flag any activity planned on a date its place is closed (closures and closed_weekdays)
Stays must cover 20 Dec to 9 Jan without gaps
31 Dec should be at a ryokan with dinner included
Show effort_for_her and avoid_for_her on every planned item

facts.text: Kyoto accommodation tax from 1 Mar 2026: ¥400 per person per night at ¥6,000-19,999, ¥1,000 at ¥20,000-49,999

deadlines.item: Ghibli Museum tickets for December dates go on sale
About now: book the Nohi bus Kanazawa → Shirakawa-go → Takayama for 28 Dec (two tickets)
Sumo January tournament tickets on sale, if extending to 10 Jan
Ghibli Museum tickets for January dates go on sale
About a month ahead: reserve shinkansen seats for 24 Dec, then each later leg
Book the New Year's Eve ryokan and the Kanazawa geiko afternoon (Sat 26 Dec)
